title.note: Game title, glossary keep (brand). Arabic players see Latin titles as the developer ships them; the string is all Latin, so its LTR direction is correct.

hud.cast.note: Verbal noun, the button style of Roblox's Arabic UI (guide); casting the line is رمي الصنارة. Pairs with سحب on hud.reel.

hud.reel.note: Verbal noun 'pulling (the line) in'; same word as the pass name سحب تلقائي.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form: '{count} طعم' would need a different noun form for 1, 2, 3-10 and 11+. Damma on طُعم so it cannot be read as طَعم (taste).

catch.success.note: Rarity as a tag in parentheses (guide pattern): an adjective after {fish} cannot agree with a fish name of unknown gender. The colon keeps {fish} standalone, so indefinite names like شبوط ذهبي need no accusative alif. اصطدت is gender-neutral in writing.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit as the generic السمكة (the fish), as the context allows.

catch.new_record.note: كغ is the standard Arabic abbreviation for kg (Levant, Iraq, North Africa); Egypt and Saudi Arabia usually write كجم. Developer: {weight} keeps its decimal point (12.4), which Arabic readers accept.

fish.golden_carp.note: شبوط is the MSA word for carp; many kids know it as كارب (Levant, Gulf) or مبروك (Egypt). A native reviewer should pick the most widely known one. Indefinite base form, as the guide does for item names.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Translated per glossary, keeping the lantern idea (الفانوس). أنقليس is the standard word for eel; the folk name ثعبان البحر (sea snake) was avoided because the fish lives in a lake and ثعبان alone reads as snake.

rarity.mythic.note: Legendary is أسطوري (guide), so Mythic takes خرافي (mythical), the usual pairing in Arabic game rarity tiers (unverified for Roblox). Arabic does not rank the two words by itself; the tier order and color must show that خرافي is above أسطوري. Masculine tag form.

shop.rods.note: صنارة = fishing rod (also spelled سنارة in some regions); the regular plural is easier for kids than صنانير.

shop.equip.note: Verbal noun button, like شراء and استلام.

shop.equipped.note: Feminine participle agreeing with صنارة (rod). If this label is ever reused for masculine items, it needs its own key.

shop.free.note: Adverb 'for free', the usual Arabic price tag; needs no agreement with the item.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide reference wording; بـ with tatweel and a space before the number.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: طُعم الحظ يضاعف فرصتك في صيد الأسماك النادرة!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name first, as on the card; it starts with an Arabic word so the line is RTL. Developer: test the <b> span in Studio (guide, Rendering); if the pieces land out of order, bold the whole line. Damma on طُعم keeps 'bait of luck' from reading as 'taste of luck'.

sell.done.note: Restructured into labels: '{count} سمكة' and '{coins} عملة' break for 1, 2 and 3-10. Reads 'Sold! Fish: 12, coins: 340'.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern (اضغط على E للفتح). Agreeing with the source-side issue: as a ProximityPrompt, ActionText بيع alone would serve phone and console players too.

ascend.button.note: ارتقاء = rising to a higher level, a common word for prestige or upgrading, with no religious or climbing sense (صعود and معراج avoided). Not the guide's rebirth term ميلاد جديد, so Ascend stays its own mechanic. No settled Arabic Roblox term found.

ascend.confirm.text: ارتقاء الآن؟ ستبدأ من جديد، لكنك ستصطاد الأسماك النادرة أكثر بنسبة {bonus}%.
ascend.confirm.note: Built like the guide's rebirth.confirm. 'more often' rendered as أكثر بنسبة {bonus}% (25% more); ASCII % right after the number.

weather.storm.text: تقترب عاصفة! الأسماك النادرة تلتقط الطُعم الآن.
weather.storm.note: 'biting' = taking the bait (تلتقط الطُعم), the fishing sense. الآن carries the English progressive 'are biting'.

quest.catch_n.text: اصطد السمك في خليج ضوء القمر: {n}
quest.catch_n.note: 'Catch {n} fish' cannot take a counted noun after the number in Arabic (1, 2, 3-10 and 11+ all differ), so {n} goes last as a target count and السمك is the number-neutral collective. Developer: if the quest line also shows progress like 3/10, check the two numbers do not read as one.

friends.boost.text: الصيد مع الأصدقاء يزيد حظك بنسبة {percent}%
friends.boost.note: The '+' is dropped on purpose: the guide says a leading + shows on the wrong side in an RTL line ('10%+'), so يزيد (raises) carries it. Statement, not an order.

trade.sent.note: Starts in Arabic; إلى before the name, never a joined لـ.

trade.accept.note: The verb agrees with اللاعب (the player), a fixed-gender noun, so it is correct for any {player} (guide pattern). 'your trade' = the trade request, the only one in play.

codes.enter.note: Guide reference; hamza on alef (type in).

codes.redeemed.note: تفعيل الكود (code activated) is how Arab kids talk about codes; Roblox's Redeem button word استرداد reads as 'refund' or 'recover' in a sentence.

afk.kicked.text: بقيت بلا نشاط لفترة طويلة، فتوقفت عن الصيد.
afk.kicked.note: بلا نشاط (without activity) instead of غير نشط keeps it gender-neutral in writing; no removal from the server is added.

event.ends.note: Implied subject is the event (masculine). Developer: {time} arrives as Latin '2d 4h', which renders correctly but reads foreign; the guide asks for Roblox's Arabic style '2 يوم 4 س' if the game formats time per locale.

daily.streak.text: اليوم {day} على التوالي! مكافآت أكثر في انتظارك غدًا.
daily.streak.note: 'Day {day} streak' as 'day {day} in a row', the natural Arabic for a streak; no counted noun after the number. 'Come back tomorrow for more' rephrased as 'more rewards await you tomorrow' to avoid a gendered imperative. On day 1 it reads a little odd, as the English does.

tip.night.text: نصيحة: بعض الأسماك لا تلتقط الطُعم إلا ليلًا.
tip.night.note: 'bite' = take the bait, same phrase as weather.storm.

group.join.text: انضم إلى مجتمعنا واحصل على 50 طُعمًا مجانًا!
group.join.note: مجتمع is Roblox's Arabic word for groups (Communities); 'our community' is the guide's wording for a studio group. 50 takes a singular accusative noun (طُعمًا), correct for this fixed number.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest Catch' = heaviest fish, so أثقل (heaviest) rather than أكبر (largest), as the context asks.
